verdict.rationale: IRCC's public work-permit page links to "Check your application status" (ircc-docs-7), and a public processing-times checker gives backward-looking, per-application-type estimates (ircc-docs-6, ircc-supp-1). However, the evidence never describes how the status check works or what it shows. The processing-times tool is generic rather than case-specific, and accounts such as GCKey suggest individual status may sit behind a login rather than on public pages (ircc-docs-8). Missing for 10: documentation of what the status lookup shows and whether it works without logging in, a case-specific status view on public pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
